description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] based on entry element damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Elena] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Elena
description.text: Increases [Fire/Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Elena after using a Fire or Lightning ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Elite Resolve+
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, causes [Imperil Fire 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (5s)] to the target

description.name: Rookie Sneak Attack+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (? each), grants [Sharpshooter Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Elena
description.text: Grants [100% Critical 2] and [Quick Cast 2] to user / [100% Critical (15s)] and [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] to all allies with 0-3/4+ VII allies in the party

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
